scientific_scope: Freeze an outcome-nonadaptive, non-promotional simulation and reporting protocol for a post-hoc same-study cross-apparatus consistency audit of the already-frozen P4-v1 candidate-307 mechanism in the Poissonnier 2026 Experiment 2 Y-maze geometry. Biological Y-maze summaries are already known/materialized, so this protocol deliberately defines no validation pass/fail threshold and no promotion rule.

frozen_model_under_audit.future_execution_model_rule: Implementation gate must create a model that is baseline-locomotion-identical to canonical locomotion and P4-structure-identical to the frozen P4 model, replacing only sigma_field_mm, kappa_trail_per_s, and theta_detect with the exact candidate-307 values above. No other biological or numerical value may change.

apparatus_interpretation.derived_apparatus_rule: Both future apparatus files must preserve the base apparatus world, geometry, boundary, entry points, and terminal regions byte-for-value. The only addition is apparatus.external_fields.painted_trail using the already-supported line_segment_scalar_field semantics.
apparatus_interpretation.opposite_arm_interpretation: DCM arm has no active painted-trail scalar field; no negative or repulsive field is introduced.

scoring.choice_definition_for_audit: First entry into the engineering endpoint circle of either branch; timeout if neither region is reached by 90 s.
scoring.interpretation_limit: Because the publication/supplements do not specify the exact spatial decision line used for Experiment 2, simulated choice rates are engineering-scored consistency outputs, not an exact reconstruction of the biological scoring operation.

simulation_design.seed_rule: For i=0..999, seed=8210000+i is used once with the left-marked apparatus and once with the right-marked apparatus. Paired seeds provide common-random-number side balancing without changing canonical biology RNG semantics.
simulation_design.neutral_seed_rule: For i=0..999, seed=8310000+i uses the unchanged neutral Y-maze geometry and canonical locomotion / exact P4 zero-dose identity to report completion and left/right symmetry. Neutral runs are diagnostic, not a fitted comparator.
simulation_design.side_balance_rule: Overall marked-arm choice probability gives exactly equal simulation weight to left-marked and right-marked conditions regardless of timeout count; side-specific completion and choice rates are always reported separately.
simulation_design.study_condition_projection_rule: P4-v1 has no direction, experience, colony, or pheromone-side response parameter. The same side-balanced model prediction is therefore projected to all four published Experiment 2 direction/experience strata; no stratum-specific simulation parameter or fit is allowed.

two_stage_outcome_firewall.stage_A_rule: The future runner must generate the complete simulation-only artifact without reading, importing, parsing, or receiving semantic values from reference/poissonnier2026_published_targets.json, reference/poissonnier2026_inventory.json, raw Experiment 2 choices, or any derivative Y-maze biological outcome file.
two_stage_outcome_firewall.stage_A_freeze_requirement: Stage A report bytes, Git blob SHA, SHA-256, runner blob, fitted-model blob, apparatus blobs, seed contract, and execution run/job/artifact identity must be frozen before Stage B is allowed.
two_stage_outcome_firewall.stage_B_rule: Only after Stage A is frozen may a separate comparison step load the two already-known pinned summary artifacts and compute the predeclared comprehensive descriptive discrepancies. Stage B may not alter Stage A, rerun simulations, change parameters, choose a different metric subset, or create a pass/fail threshold.

predeclared_simulation_reporting.uncertainty_rule: Report Wilson 95% intervals for each binomial choice fraction among completed choices. Do not convert an interval into a validation decision.
predeclared_simulation_reporting.timeout_rule: Timeouts are never silently dropped: counts and fractions use the explicit denominator stated in each field, and timeout fraction is reported for every condition.

required_biological_summary_comparisons: overall published pheromone-arm choice rate versus side-balanced model marked-arm choice fraction
each of the four published direction/experience condition rates versus the same shared model prediction
published left-phero rate versus left-marked model rate
published right-phero rate versus right-marked model rate

next_gate.purpose: Authorize implementation only of the exact frozen fitted model, paired left/right marked apparatus files, fixed experiments, and two-stage consistency runner/reporting surface. Reference-free engineering qualification must precede any official Stage A execution.

separate_promotion_grade_track: P4_external_validation_source_discovery_v1 remains required before any external-validation or canonical-promotion claim.
